critical.issue: Counter migration missing: documents created before the switch to documenti_counters (old max+1 numbering) have no counter doc. DB check found 6 (user,kind,anno) groups with existing numbered docs and NO counter (e.g. user GLlIP7... has CE 2026 up to n.4, manutenzione 2026 up to n.2). Next POST for those users will restart at n.1 -> duplicate document numbers. Fix: when counter is missing, seed it from max(numero) of existing documenti (e.g. startup migration, or $max on upsert using find of last numero) before $inc.

minor.issue: No unique index on (user_id, kind, anno); concurrent first-time upserts can theoretically create two counter docs (test with 6 parallel POSTs passed, but add the unique index for safety).

issues: Third tab label 'Manutenzioni' (icon + text) is tight/clipped against the right edge of the grid-cols-3 pill; consider shorter label or smaller text/icon on mobile
